arxiv-2107-09966.title: Provenance, Anonymisation and Data Environments: a Unifying Construction
arxiv-2107-09966.creator: Muhammad Aslam Jarwar, Adriane Chapman, Mark Elliot, Fatemeh Raji
arxiv-2107-09966.description: Abstract The Anonymisation Decision-making Framework (ADF) operationalizes the risk management of data exchange between organizations, referred to as "data environments". The second edition of ADF has increased its emphasis on modeling data flows, highlighting a potential new use of provenance information to support anonymisation decision-making. In this paper, we provide a use case that showcases this functionality more.

arxiv-2203-08625.title: Cloud-convection feedback in brown dwarfs atmosphere
arxiv-2203-08625.creator: Maxence Lefèvre, Xianyu Tan, Elspeth K. H. Lee, R. T. Pierrehumbert
arxiv-2203-08625.description: Abstract Abstract Numerous observational evidence has suggested the presence of active meteorology in the atmospheres of brown dwarfs. A near-infrared brightness variability has been observed. Clouds have a major role in shaping the thermal structure and spectral properties of these atmospheres.

arxiv-2204-03627.title: Canonical partition function and center symmetry breaking in finite density lattice gauge theories
arxiv-2204-03627.creator: Shinji Ejiri
arxiv-2204-03627.description: Abstract We study the nature of the phase transition of lattice gauge theories at high temperature and high density by focusing on the probability distribution function, which represents the probability that a certain density will be realized in a heat bath.

arxiv-2204-04176.title: Path Defense in Dynamic Defender-Attacker Blotto Games (dDAB) with Limited Information
arxiv-2204-04176.creator: Austin K. Chen, Bryce L. Ferguson, Daigo Shishika, Michael Dorothy, Jason R. Marden, George J. Pappas, Vijay Kumar
arxiv-2204-04176.description: Abstract We consider a path guarding problem in dynamic Defender-Attacker Blotto games (dDAB), where a team of robots must defend a path in a graph against adversarial agents. Multi-robot systems are particularly well suited to this application, as recent work has shown the effectiveness of these systems in related areas such as perimeter defense and surveillance.

arxiv-2206-05609.title: Maximal operators associated with Fourier multipliers and applications Thanks: J. B. Lee is supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea(NRF) grant 2021R1C1C2008252 and the National Research Foundation of Korea(NRF) grant 2022R1A4A1018904
arxiv-2206-05609.creator: Jin Bong Lee, Jinsol Seo
arxiv-2206-05609.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce a criterion for maximal operators associated with Fourier multipliers to be bounded on L p ​ ( ℝ d ) L^{p}(\mathbb{R}^{d}) for each p ∈ ( 1 , ∞ ) p\in(1,\infty) . Noteworthy examples satisfying the criterion are multipliers of the Mikhlin type or limited decay which are not necessarily radial.

arxiv-2302-02524.title: Image Pre-processing for Improving Deep Learning Classification of Retinopathy of Prematurity
arxiv-2302-02524.creator: Sajid Rahim, Dr Kourosh Sabri, Dr Anna Ells, Dr Alan Wassyng, Dr Mark Lawford, Dr Wenbo He, Dr Linyang Chu
arxiv-2302-02524.description: Abstract . Retinopathy of Prematurity (ROP) can affect babies born prematurely. It is a potentially blinding eye disorder because of damage to the eye’s retina. Screening of ROP is essential for early detection and treatment. This is a laborious and manual process which requires a trained physician performing a dilated ophthalmology examination.

arxiv-2304-06456.title: Supersolid Stacks in Antidipolar Bose-Einstein Condensates
arxiv-2304-06456.creator: K. Mukherjee, M. Nilsson Tengstrand, T. Arnone Cardinale, S. M. Reimann
arxiv-2304-06456.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate a novel supersolid structure taking the form of stacked, disk-shaped superfluid droplets connected via a dilute superfluid, in an antidipolar condensate. A phase diagram is determined for varying the particle number and scattering length, identifying the regions of a regular dipolar superfluid, supersolid stacks, and isolated stacked disk-shaped droplets in an experimentally realizable trapping potential.

arxiv-2305-00796.title: Some comments on piecewise-projective groups of the line
arxiv-2305-00796.creator: Nicolas Monod
arxiv-2305-00796.description: Abstract . We consider groups of piecewise-projective homeomorphisms of the line which are known to be non-amenable using notably the Carrière–Ghys theorem on ergodic equivalence relations. Replacing that theorem by an explicit fixed-point argument, we can strengthen the conclusion and exhibit uncountably many “amenability gaps” between various piecewise-projective groups.

arxiv-2305-09939.title: Electroweak penguins and radiative B decays at Belle II
arxiv-2305-09939.creator: C. Praz, on behalf of the Belle II collaboration
arxiv-2305-09939.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by C. Praz, on behalf of the Belle II collaboration. Decays of B B mesons involving the transition of a b b quark into an s s quark are good probes of physics beyond the standard model. Such decays are studied at the Belle II experiment, a detector located along the SuperKEKB electron-positron collider, and with data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 189 ​ fb − 1 189\,\mathrm{fb^{-1}} collected at the energy of the Υ ⁡ ( 4 ​ S ) \Upsilon(4S) resonance.

arxiv-2306-07611.title: Outerplane bipartite graphs with isomorphic resonance graphs
arxiv-2306-07611.description: Abstract We present novel results related to isomorphic resonance graphs of 2-connected outerplane bipartite graphs. As the main result, we provide a structure characterization for 2-connected outerplane bipartite graphs with isomorphic resonance graphs. Moreover, two additional characterizations are expressed in terms of resonance digraphs and via local structures of inner duals of 2-connected outerplane bipartite graphs, respectively.

arxiv-2306-12125.title: High-dimensional Tensor Response Regression using the t -Distribution
arxiv-2306-12125.creator: Ning Wang, Xin Zhang, Qing Mai
arxiv-2306-12125.description: Abstract In recent years, promising statistical modeling approaches to tensor data analysis have been rapidly developed. Traditional multivariate analysis tools, such as multivariate regression and discriminant analysis, are generalized from modeling random vectors and matrices to higher-order random tensors. One of the biggest challenges to statistical tensor models is the non-Gaussian nature of many real-world data.

arxiv-2407-03262.title: Root Ridge Leverage Score Sampling for ℓ p \ell_{p} Subspace Approximation Thanks: Part of this work was done while T.Y. was at Carnegie Mellon University.
arxiv-2407-03262.creator: David P. Woodruff, Taisuke Yasuda
arxiv-2407-03262.description: Abstract The ℓ p \ell_{p} subspace approximation problem is an NP-hard low rank approximation problem that generalizes the median hyperplane problem ( p = 1 p=1 ), principal component analysis ( p = 2 p=2 ), and the center hyperplane problem ( p = ∞ p=\infty ).

arxiv-2408-15640.title: GANs Conditioning Methods: A Survey
arxiv-2408-15640.creator: Anis Bourou anis.bourou@ens.psl.eu, Valérie Mezger valerie.mezger@gmail.com, Auguste Genovesio auguste.genovesio@ens.psl.eu
arxiv-2408-15640.description: Abstract In recent years, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have seen significant advancements, leading to their widespread adoption across various fields. The original GAN architecture enables the generation of images without any specific control over the content, making it an unconditional generation process.

arxiv-2409-04395.title: Suppressing Gauge Drift in Quantum Simulations with Gauge Transformations
arxiv-2409-04395.creator: Carter Ball
arxiv-2409-04395.description: Abstract The simulation of quantum lattice gauge theories faces the major challenge of maintaining gauge invariance, as various errors in the simulation push the state of the system out of the physical subspace of the system’s exponentially larger Hilbert space.

arxiv-2412-13034.title: Unified calibration and spatial mapping of fine particulate matter data from multiple low-cost air pollution sensor networks in Baltimore, Maryland
arxiv-2412-13034.creator: Claire Heffernan, Kirsten Koehler, Drew R. Gentner, Roger D. Peng, Abhirup Datta
arxiv-2412-13034.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Claire Heffernan, Kirsten Koehler, Drew R. Gentner, Roger D. Peng, Abhirup Datta. Low-cost air pollution sensor networks are increasingly being deployed globally, supplementing sparse regulatory monitoring with localized air quality data. In some areas, like Baltimore, Maryland, there are only few regulatory (reference) devices but multiple low-cost networks.

arxiv-2505-21629.title: Stealing galaxies from galaxy clusters
arxiv-2505-21629.creator: M. Smole, M. Micic, A. Mitrašinović
arxiv-2505-21629.description: Abstract We investigate galaxy groups that reside in the field but have been previously processed by galaxy clusters. Observationally, they would appear to have the same properties as regular field groups at first glance. However, one would expect to find quantifiable differences in processed groups as dynamical interactions within clusters perturb them.

arxiv-2506-14213.title: Chaining Event Spans for Temporal Relation Grounding
arxiv-2506-14213.creator: Jongho Kim, Dohyeon Lee, Minsoo Kim, Seung-won Hwang
arxiv-2506-14213.description: Abstract Accurately understanding temporal relations between events is a critical building block of diverse tasks, such as temporal reading comprehension (TRC) and relation extraction (TRE). For example in TRC, we need to understand the temporal semantic differences between the following two questions that are lexically near-identical: ‘‘What finished right before the decision?’’ or ‘‘What finished right after the decision?’’.

arxiv-2507-20750.title: Physical Constraints on the Rhythmicity of the Biological Clock
arxiv-2507-20750.creator: YeongKyu Lee, Changbong Hyeon
arxiv-2507-20750.description: Abstract Circadian rhythms in living organisms are temporal orders emerging from biochemical circuits driven out of equilibrium. Here, we study how the rhythmicity of a biochemical clock is shaped using the KaiABC system. A phase diagram constructed as a function of KaiC and KaiA concentrations reveals a sharply bounded limit-cycle region, which naturally explains arrhythmia upon protein over-expression.

arxiv-2509-06183.title: Forward and inverse problems of a semilinear transport equation
arxiv-2509-06183.creator: Kui Ren, Yimin Zhong
arxiv-2509-06183.description: Abstract We study forward and inverse problems for a semilinear radiative transport model where the absorption coefficient depends on the angular average of the transport solution. Our first result is the well-posedness theory for the transport model with general boundary data, which significantly improves previous theories for small boundary data.

arxiv-2602-05537.title: A Novel Mechanism of Ordering in a Coupled Driven System: Vacancy Induced Phase Separation
arxiv-2602-05537.creator: Chandradip Khamrai and Sakuntala Chatterjee
arxiv-2602-05537.description: Abstract We study a coupled driven system where two different species of particles, along with some vacancies or holes, move on a landscape whose shape fluctuates with time. The movement of the particles is guided by the local shape of the landscape, and this shape is also affected by the presence of different particle species.

arxiv-2603-04702.title: Successive single- q q and double- q q orders in an anisotropic XY model on the diamond structure: a model for quadrupole ordering in PrIr 2 Zn 20
arxiv-2603-04702.creator: Kaito Sasa, Kazumasa Hattori

gao-gaoreports-gao-05-706t.description: Social Security: Societal Changes Add Challenges to Program Protections (2005).

plos-pone-0006060.creator: Joke Bilcke, Pierre Van Damme, Marc Van Ranst et al.
plos-pone-0006060.description: PLOS ONE research article. pmc-10636003.title: Temperature-dependent photo-elastic coefficient of silicon at 1550 nm
pmc-10636003.creator: Johannes Dickmann, Jan Meyer, Mika Gaedtke, Stefanie Kroker
pmc-10636003.description: This paper presents a study on the temperature dependent photo-elastic coefficient in single-crystal silicon with (100) and (110) orientations at a wavelength of 1550 nm. The measurement of the photo-elastic coefficient was performed using a polarimetric scheme across a wide temperature range from 5 to 300 K.

pmc-11348570.title: Inhibition of bromodomain and extra-terminal proteins targets constitutively active NFκB and STAT signaling in lymphoma and influences the expression of the antiapoptotic proteins BCL2A1 and c-MYC
pmc-11348570.creator: Nadja M Pieper, Julia Schnell, Daniela Bruecher, Stefan Knapp, Meike Vogler
pmc-11348570.description: The antiapoptotic protein BCL2A1 is highly, but very heterogeneously expressed in Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma (DLBCL). Particularly in the context of resistance to current therapies, BCL2A1 appears to play an important role in protecting cancer cells from the induction of cell death. Reducing BCL2A1 levels may have therapeutic potential, however, no specific inhibitor is currently available.

pmc-11516856.title: Vaccination in the post pandemic era - a qualitative study of the experiences of Somali immigrants
pmc-11516856.creator: R N Gleditsch, T S Ofitserova, B A Winje, N S Sheikh, T S Skogheim, B T Hansen
pmc-11516856.description: BackgroundThe Somali population is the largest non-European immigrant group in Norway and past studies have indicated lower coverage for both childhood vaccines and COVID-19. However, little is known about views and experiences of vaccination among this group and how their experiences might impact their vaccination decision-making process. This study explored views and experiences with vaccination among Somali immigrants in Norway.

pmc-11525407.title: PKG1 promotes the HIV-induced proliferation, migration, and fibrosis of vascular smooth muscle cells of hemorrhoids
pmc-11525407.creator: Zhen Li, Zhong Chen, Chun Liu, Shuang Peng, Ning Wang
pmc-11525407.description: BackgroundHemorrhoids are very common in patients with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection. The risk of postoperative infection is significantly greater in HIV-positive patients than in HIV-negative individuals, and the wound healing time is significantly prolonged. This study aimed to investigate the role of HIV-associated hemorrhoids from the perspective of vascular smooth muscle cell (VSMC) function.

pmc-12591340.title: Rescue Transesophageal Echocardiography
pmc-12591340.creator: Thushara Madathil, Praveen K. Neema
pmc-12591340.description: involving acute unexplained hemodynamic instability [Figure 1], refractory arrhythmias or electrocardiographic changes (ST, T wave changes), hypoxia, and cardiac arrest.[2] As the name suggests, it is not an elective or planned procedure but is initiated in the event of a clinical emergency.

pmc-12722670.title: Genetic links between periodontal disease and circulating leptin and resistin: A Mendelian randomization study
pmc-12722670.creator: Yanan Jing, Junfei Zhu
pmc-12722670.description: ObjectiveThe relationship between periodontal disease and adipokines has been extensively investigated. Using a Mendelian randomization approach, this study aimed to determine whether circulating leptin and resistin levels are causally implicated in the etiology of periodontal disease and whether the genetic risk of periodontal disease influences circulating adipokine levels.

pmc-12997225.title: The health sector – led campaign to realise Australia’s national Strategy on health and climate change
pmc-12997225.creator: Fiona Armstrong
pmc-12997225.description: This article outlines some of the key stages in a long-running and groundbreaking campaign for a national strategy on climate and health for Australia. It is hoped this account will be a source of inspiration for others seeking to accelerate climate action in ways that protect and promote health and wellbeing.

pmc-13458248.title: Optimizing Teacher–Occupational Therapist Collaboration: A Multimethod Knowledge Translation Initiative
pmc-13458248.creator: Lina Ianni, Chantal Camden, Wenonah Campbell, Heather Colquhoun, Dana Anaby
pmc-13458248.description: IntroductionSupporting students with special needs in inclusive schools requires collaboration between teachers and occupational therapists (OTs). While service models promoting health, in‐class support and shared knowledge are recommended, relational and organizational barriers persist. This multimethod study evaluates the impact of a tailored knowledge translation (KT) intervention on collaborative attitudes and behaviours of OT–teacher teams.

pmc-13597790.title: A case of recurrent acute acalculous cholecystitis in a patient with renal cell carcinoma treated with pazopanib and axitinib: case report and literature review
pmc-13597790.creator: Xiaolu Zeng, Jing Zhang, Chen Chen, Xueru Sun, Lei Yang
pmc-13597790.description: A 74-year-old male patient with renal cell carcinoma developed disease progression in the left adrenal gland and lungs 12.8 years after surgery. He presented with symptoms of cholecystitis 4 weeks after starting pazopanib and 8 weeks after starting axitinib. The symptoms were relieved after treatment with drug discontinuation, anti-infective therapy and symptomatic supportive care.

uslaw-usc-t29-s6.description: United States Code, Title 29 (Labor); Chapter 1 (Labor Statistics); Subchapter I (Bureau Of Labor Statistics). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Commissioner of Labor Statistics shall annually make a report in writing to the President and Congress, of the information collected and collated by him, and containing such recommendations as he may deem calculated to promote the efficiency of the department.
